editorial.headline: Factory Technical Design Is Open Nationally and in Bali
editorial.standfirst: This factory-focused consultancy and design activity is open to PMA at every listed business scale, with a 100% national foreign-ownership ceiling and no Bali moratorium block.
editorial.body:
**71102** covers professional technical consultancy and design focused on factories. Its work concerns the planning, construction, dismantling and relocation of factories, including machinery, equipment and other parts of a plant. The scope is deliberately wide in the considerations it may take in: economic, social, cultural, environmental, natural-resource and other aspects can all form part of the assignment. This is therefore an activity concerned with the technical planning and transition of factory operations, from their establishment through physical change or relocation.

The record also includes substantial geospatial services. These include terrestrial geospatial data acquisition, particularly three-dimensional positioning of geodetic control points and the measurement of angles, distance, area and height differences. It covers ground control-point surveys, horizontal and vertical control networks, detailed situation surveys, utility surveys, toponym surveys, boundary-affirmation surveys and gravity surveys. The activity further encompasses planning and supervision documents for geospatial data acquisition using terrestrial, photogrammetric, remote-sensing and hydrographic methods; aerial-photo and imagery processing; geospatial database design and construction; spatial and regional analysis; the presentation of geospatial information; and the management and dissemination of geospatial data and information.

The activity is open to businesses at Mikro, Kecil, Menengah and Besar scales. Nationally, it is TERBUKA to PMA, with a foreign-ownership ceiling of 100%. That is a full foreign-ownership ceiling, not a partial stake. The record identifies Perpres 10/2021, 49/2021 as the source for that national position. A business registering this activity should therefore be carrying out the stated factory consultancy, technical design or included geospatial services, at one of the four listed scales.

Bali does not reverse the national position. The province’s permanent, island-wide moratorium blocks PMA registration for low- and medium-low-risk KBLI activities. For this activity, however, the Bali record states that the OSS risk at the Besar scale is Medium-High/High, so it is not blocked by that moratorium. Bali’s status is OK or Higher Risk rather than blocked. A foreign investor can register this activity in Bali today: the national 100% ceiling remains in place, and the Bali risk note explains why the moratorium does not prevent registration.
